run_generate_mask: run the script with --dataset_path to generate epipolar error masks and videos from a video dataset
run_maskrcnn_segmentation: run Mask R-CNN on an image to produce a binary mask excluding people, vehicles, animals, and accessories
compute_sampson_error: compute the Sampson error for point correspondences given a fundamental matrix F
get_uv_grid: get a normalized UV coordinate grid tensor for a given image height and width
warp_flow: warp an image using an optical flow field with OpenCV remap
